caption:
Watching him to the corner

He says she can go inside. She stays on the step and watches him all the way to the corner.

Standing there costs two minutes, and the last thing they see is someone still there.

For whoever waits until a friend turns the corner.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A street with an open door on the far left and a street sign on a pole that says Elm on the far right. Two block figures with white eyes stand together, one ink-black and one royal blue. The royal blue one says you can go in. The ink-black one says till the corner. The royal blue one strolls to the right toward the sign, the ink-black one stays and watches. At the corner the royal blue one turns around and both turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, watching till the corner.
